item.title: Autogen
item.description: Autogen is an open-source framework developed by Microsoft for building agentic AI systems. It provides a flexible set of agent classes and utilities that enable the creation of multi-agent workflows, conversational agents, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines. With Autogen, developers can orchestrate interactions between humans, LLM-powered assistants, and specialized tool agents to solve complex tasks in a collaborative and autonomous manner.
